_comment: Wall ms per test file from a real run; only used to balance the CI shards (scripts/testShards.mjs). Regenerate from GitHub, where the PGlite-heavy files weigh differently than on a fast laptop: gh run download <ci.yml run id> -p "server-shard-durations-*" -D /tmp/d && node scripts/merge-durations.mjs scripts/test-durations.json /tmp/d/*/shard-durations.json. Locally: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --write-durations scripts/test-durations.json. A file missing here still runs (hash shard).
